title: An item appended to a multi-line flow sequence goes inside it after a flow-keyed last entry
notes:
The sequence holds one single-pair entry whose key is a flow sequence (yaml-test-suite 4FJ6 has the same shape). The new item follows the last entry, separated by `, `, and the closing bracket stays last. `[a]: 1
], zz` would put the item after the sequence, outside it, which is not a sequence item: the written text does not read back as the sequence plus an item. The exact bytes rest on a kit convention (docs/edit-semantics.md).

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the pure backend wrote the item after the closing bracket.
